models.name: todo_list_guests
models.description:
Unauthenticated visitor tracking for the Todo list application.

Represents anonymous visitors who have not registered or logged in. This table tracks basic interaction data for guests accessing public pages such as registration and login screens.

Guests have no access to todo management features and cannot create, view, or modify any todo items. The primary purpose is to track visitor engagement metrics and pre-registration behavior for analytics.

This is a subsidiary entity managed by the system for tracking purposes rather than direct user management.

plainFields.name: ip_address
plainFields.description: IP address of the guest visitor for tracking and security purposes.

plainFields.name: user_agent
plainFields.description: Browser user agent string identifying the client application and device type.

plainFields.name: visited_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest first visited the application.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this guest record was created in the system.

models.name: todo_list_users
models.description:
Authenticated user accounts for the Todo list application.

Represents registered members who can create, manage, and organize their personal todo items. Each user account is identified by a unique email address and secured with hashed password authentication.

Users have complete ownership and privacy of their todo data. Each user can only access and modify their own todo items, ensuring strict data isolation. The system enforces user-level permissions through JWT token authentication.

This table stores core identity information including email credentials and account status. Related user sessions are tracked in the todo_list_user_sessions table for authentication management.

Users are the primary actors in the application, with full access to todo creation, updating, completion tracking, filtering, sorting, and deletion operations on their owned data.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: User email address used for authentication and account identification. Must be unique across all user accounts.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Securely hashed user password using bcrypt with minimum cost factor of 10. Never store plain text passwords.

plainFields.name: email_verified
plainFields.description: Whether the user has verified their email address. Users must verify email before accessing full application features.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user account was created during registration.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user account information was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. When set, indicates the user account has been deleted but preserved for audit purposes.

models.name: todo_list_user_sessions
models.description:
Active authentication sessions for registered users.

Tracks user login sessions with connection context and temporal information for security audit trails. Each session represents a distinct login event from a specific device or location.

Users can have multiple concurrent sessions across different devices. Session data enables tracking of user activity, detecting suspicious login patterns, and providing users visibility into their active sessions for security management.

Sessions are automatically created upon successful user authentication and can be terminated through logout actions. The system invalidates all sessions when security-sensitive operations occur, such as password changes.

This subsidiary entity is managed through user authentication workflows rather than direct user manipulation.

foreignFields.name: todo_list_user_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the authenticated user who owns this session. {@link todo_list_users.id}

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the session connection was established.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Connection URL where the session was initiated.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL that led to the session creation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp when the user successfully authenticated.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration timestamp when the session ended or was terminated. Null for active sessions.

models.name: todo_list_admins
models.description:
System administrator accounts with elevated privileges.

Represents administrative users who can manage user accounts, monitor system health, and perform system-wide operations. Admins have access to administrative functions including user management, system statistics, and configuration.

For their personal todo management, admins follow the same data ownership rules as regular users - they can only access and modify their own todo items. Administrative privileges do not grant access to other users' private todo data except for legitimate support purposes with audit logging.

Admin accounts are created by existing administrators through elevated authentication processes. Each admin action is logged for accountability and security compliance.

This is a primary entity requiring independent account management and authentication workflows separate from regular user accounts.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Administrator email address used for authentication. Must be unique across all admin accounts.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Securely hashed administrator password using bcrypt. Admin passwords follow the same security requirements as user passwords.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the administrator account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the administrator account information was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for admin accounts. Maintains audit trail for removed administrator access.

models.name: todo_list_admin_sessions
models.description:
Active authentication sessions for system administrators.

Tracks administrator login sessions with connection metadata for security monitoring and audit trails. Admin sessions are managed separately from user sessions to enable distinct security policies and monitoring.

All administrative actions are associated with specific sessions for accountability. The system logs session creation, activity, and termination to maintain comprehensive audit trails of administrator access.

Admin sessions follow the same concurrent session support as user sessions, allowing administrators to maintain multiple active sessions across different devices.

This subsidiary entity is managed through administrative authentication workflows.

foreignFields.name: todo_list_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the administrator who owns this session. {@link todo_list_admins.id}

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the admin session connection was established.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Connection URL where the admin session was initiated.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL that led to the admin session creation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Admin session creation timestamp when authentication succeeded.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Admin session expiration timestamp. Null for currently active sessions.

models.name: todo_list_email_verifications
models.description:
Email verification tokens for user account activation.

Stores unique verification tokens sent to users during registration to confirm email ownership. Each token is associated with a user account and has a limited validity period for security.

When a user registers, the system generates a verification token and sends it via email. Users must click the verification link containing the token to activate their account and gain full access to the application.

Tokens expire after 24 hours to prevent abuse. Expired tokens require users to request a new verification email. Once a token is successfully used for verification, it becomes invalid to prevent reuse.

This subsidiary entity is managed through the registration and email verification workflow rather than direct user interaction.

foreignFields.name: todo_list_user_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the user account requiring email verification. {@link todo_list_users.id}

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique verification token sent to the user's email address. Used to verify email ownership.

plainFields.name: verified
plainFields.description: Whether this verification token has been successfully used. Once verified, the token cannot be reused.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the verification token was generated and email was sent.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this verification token expires. Tokens are valid for 24 hours after creation.

models.name: todo_list_password_resets
models.description:
Password reset tokens for account recovery workflows.

Manages secure password reset tokens for users who have forgotten their passwords. Each token provides time-limited access to reset account credentials.

When a user requests password reset, the system generates a unique token and sends it via email. The token is valid for 1 hour, providing a secure window for password reset while minimizing exposure risk.

Tokens are single-use - once successfully used to reset a password, they become invalid. All active user sessions are terminated when a password is reset for security.

The system displays success messages for password reset requests regardless of whether the email exists, preventing email enumeration attacks.

This subsidiary entity is managed through the password reset workflow and is not directly manipulated by users.

foreignFields.name: todo_list_user_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the user account requesting password reset. {@link todo_list_users.id}

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique password reset token sent to the user's email. Used to authenticate password reset requests.

plainFields.name: used
plainFields.description: Whether this reset token has been used to successfully reset the password. Prevents token reuse.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset token was generated and email was sent.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this password reset token expires. Tokens are valid for 1 hour after creation.

models.name: todo_list_todos
models.description:
Core todo item entity representing user tasks and their management lifecycle.

Stores individual todo items created by authenticated users for personal task tracking and productivity management.
Each todo represents a single actionable task with attributes for organization, prioritization, and completion tracking.

Todos are owned by individual users with complete data isolation - users can only access and modify their own todo items.
The system enforces strict ownership boundaries ensuring privacy and data security across all operations.

Each todo contains essential task information including title, optional description, due date, priority level, and completion status.
The status field tracks the todo's lifecycle through pending, in_progress, completed, and cancelled states.
Completion tracking uses both a boolean flag and timestamp to record when tasks are finished.

Soft deletion is supported through the deleted_at field, allowing todos to be removed from active views while preserving data for potential recovery and audit purposes.
All modifications are tracked via updated_at timestamp to maintain comprehensive audit trails.

Todos support advanced organization through priority levels (low, medium, high) and optional due dates for deadline management.
The system provides filtering, sorting, and searching capabilities to help users efficiently manage large todo lists.

This is the primary business entity of the Todo List application, requiring full CRUD API operations and independent user management capabilities.

foreignFields.name: todo_list_user_id
foreignFields.description: Owner user who created this todo item. {@link todo_list_users.id}

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Todo item title - the primary description of the task. Required field with maximum 200 characters. This is the main text users see in their todo list.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional detailed description providing additional context, notes, or instructions for the task. Maximum 2000 characters. Can be empty if the title is self-explanatory.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current lifecycle status of the todo item. Valid values: pending (initial state), in_progress (actively working), completed (finished), cancelled (abandoned). Tracks the todo's workflow state.

plainFields.name: priority
plainFields.description: Task priority level for organization and sorting. Valid values: low, medium, high. Defaults to medium when not specified. Helps users identify and focus on important tasks.

plainFields.name: due_date
plainFields.description: Optional deadline for task completion. Supports past dates for backdating and future dates for planning. Used for overdue detection and timeline organization. Null indicates no specific deadline.

plainFields.name: completed
plainFields.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the task is completed. True when status is completed, false otherwise. Provides quick completion status checking without parsing status field.

plainFields.name: completed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp recording when the todo was marked as completed. Set automatically when status changes to completed. Cleared when todo is marked incomplete. Null for incomplete todos.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo item was created. Set automatically by the system at creation time. Immutable field used for chronological ordering and analytics.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to any field of the todo item. Updated automatically by the system whenever the todo is changed. Used for tracking recent activity and conflict detection.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp indicating when the todo was deleted. Null for active todos. When set, the todo is excluded from normal queries while preserved for audit trails and potential recovery.
